comments_text: Discovery: From 110 predicted candidates, 14 were made and tested. 57% predicted peptides showed activity against the ESKAPE pathogens. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is 58.82% similar to predicted RK17 L: 19%; W: 25%, K: 44%; A: 13%. Activity: Active against Gram+ E. faecium QF31 and 2 more strains (MIC 4 ug/ml), E. faecalis SF23-1 and 3 strains (MIC 8 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 29212 and 40 strains (MIC 4-32 ug/ml), S. suis P1/7 (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. pyogenes DL02 ermB (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. aga;actiae DL03 ermB (MIC 4 ug/ml), Gram- K. pneumoniae (MIC 16 ug/ml), A. baumannii AB11 (MIC 2 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa PAO1 (MIC 2 ug/ml), E. coli ATCC 25922 and 40 strains (MIC 4-32 ug/ml), S. enteritis S1 (MIC 16 ug/ml). Killing kinetics: Killed S. aureus at 2-4x MIC within 30 min. Resistance development:no:bacteria:S. aureus ATCC 29213: no resistance development after 28 passages, but ciprofloxacin MIC increased 128 fold. MOA:bacteria:E. coli: MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: the peptide depolarized and permeated bacterial membranes. Structure: random coil in water and helical in 25 mM SDS.
title: BroadAMP-GPT: AI-Driven generation of broad-spectrum antimicrobial peptides for combating multidrug-resistant ESKAPE pathogens.

comments_text: Discovery: From 110 predicted candidates, 14 were made and tested. 57% predicted peptides showed activity against the ESKAPE pathogens. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is 43.33% similar to synthetic Syn-sordellicin-73 I: 25%; A=K: 13%, G=R: 17%. Activity: Active against E. faecium QF31 (MIC 4 ug/ml), E. faecalis SF23-1 (MIC 8 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 29212 and 40 strains (MIC 4-32 ug/ml), S. suis P1/7 (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. pyogenes DL02 ermB (MIC 4 ug/ml), S. aga;actiae DL03 ermB (MIC 4 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae (MIC 16 ug/ml), A. baumannii AB11 or 7979 (MIC 8 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa PAO1 or PA14 (MIC 8 ug/ml), E. coli ATCC 25922 and 40 strains (MIC 4-32 ug/ml), and S. enteritis S1 (MIC 16 ug/ml). Killing kinetics: Killed S. aureus at 2-4x MIC within 120 min. Resistance development:no:bacteria:S. aureus ATCC 29213: no resistance development after 28 passages, but ciprofloxacin MIC increased 128 fold. MOA:bacteria:E. coli: MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: the peptide depolarized and permeated bacterial membranes. Structure: random coil in water and helical in 25 mM SDS. Animal model:wax moth:survivial expt:S. aureus: it protected Galleria mellonella from death caused by MRSA ATCC 43300 infection. Animal model:mouse:wound healing: it reduced MRSA CFU (dose-dependent) after 11 days and promoted wound healing in a 11-day test.
